extension.description: Enjoy TFC's Pinoy TV shows, movies, news and live channels! This is not an official TFC.tv addon. A subscription to TFC.tv website (http://tfc.tv) is required to enjoy TFC's catalog. iWantTFC Kodi uses Trakt but is not endorsed or certified by Trakt.
extension.news:
v3.8.0 (in development) [change] Development versions carry a ~devN suffix until the release [new] Trakt: a show is also searched without the name of its star (Coco Martin's Sigabo is Sigabo on Trakt); when Trakt can't tell which show it is, choose it among the most likely ones with the context menu (Choose the show on Trakt), the choice is kept [change] Clean-up: the old live stream code and the unused history.db are removed [fix] A header was added again at each call of the JSON API
v3.7.0 [fix] Live channels can be played again: the catalog is read for your country, as the website does (the channels of the Philippines were listed and refused elsewhere) [change] The settings use the Kodi 18+ format (same settings and values) [new] Location: the country, which decides the catalog and the live channels, is detected again at each start of Kodi (VPN, trip); this can be turned off and a country can be set by hand (Advanced > Location) [fix] The geo location service refused the request of the add-on (403), so the country was not detected on some devices
